summary: Nexera Technologies Ltd filed a prospectus supplement under Rule 424(b)(5) for a registered direct offering of 1,200,000 ordinary shares at $1.00 per share, paired with warrants exercisable at $1.00 per share for 66 months. The offering is a routine capital raise, not a special situation. There are no acquisition, divestiture, activist, strategic review, or restructuring elements. Proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes. The filing describes standard mechanics of a PIPE-like transaction with a concurrent private placement, but it does not trigger any special-situation classification; it is an ordinary shelf takedown and issuer financing.
